class.name: SaveCoordinator
class.brief_description: Coordinates checkpoint capture, storage, and restore for a persistent game host.
class.description: Submit checkpoint requests on the main thread. An admitted request returns a positive ticket and reports its result through [signal operation_finished]. A rejected request returns zero. Read the admission error and message on the same coordinator immediately after a rejection.

method.name: get_last_admission_error
method.description: Returns the stable code for the most recent admission or setup rejection, or an empty string when the coordinator has no recorded rejection. A later rejection replaces the code and a successful admission clears it. A call from outside the main thread returns [code]WrongThread[/code].

method.name: get_last_admission_message
method.description: Returns the reason or recovery guidance for the rejection reported by [method get_last_admission_error]. Read it immediately after a request returns zero. A later rejection replaces the message and a successful admission clears it. A call from outside the main thread returns guidance to submit requests on the main thread.
